Dear Jochen Triesch,

I am completing an MSc in Physics with a thesis on spiking network models of cortex. My work involved developing and analyzing these models using Python and Brian2.

I noticed your publications on spiking neural networks, including work on predictive coding and simulation tools. Although my thesis is not directly linked to your papers, my computational modeling skills might be relevant to your research.

Could you please consider me for any available PhD positions in your lab related to neural coding or spiking networks? I am interested in opportunities at the Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies and would appreciate any guidance on application procedures or openings.

Best regards,
Test Student
